## Linked issue(s)

## Type of change

- [ ] New rule (`feat(rules/...)`)
- [ ] Fix to existing rule (`fix(rules/...)`)
- [ ] Documentation only (`docs(...)`)
- [ ] Locale / i18n change (`feat(locales/...)` or `fix(locales/...)`)
- [ ] CI / tooling (`chore(ci)` / `chore(build)`)
- [ ] Refactor without behaviour change (`refactor(...)`)
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behaviour (`pnpm test` passes).
- [ ] Per-rule documentation under `docs/rules/<rule-id>.md` updated or added (for rule changes).
- [ ] Locale message bundles updated for all 5 locales (en / sv / nb / da / fi) — or explicit note for which locales need native-speaker follow-up.
- [ ] Relevant WCAG 2.2 SC and EN 301 549 paragraph cited in the rule docstring and PR description.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under `## [Unreleased]`.
- [ ] IP-boundary guard passes (`pnpm ip-guard`).
- [ ] Conventional Commits subject (e.g. `feat(rules/checkout): add discount-code-feedback rule`).
